chars.WIFE: BOSS'S WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late forties, kind round face, wearing a burgundy velvet house djellaba with gold trim and a cream headscarf tied loosely
chars.SAFOUANE: YOUNG WORKER: a thin Moroccan young man of 19, short black curly hair, wearing a faded mustard-yellow hoodie with aluminium dust, dark grey work trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the hallway of a Moroccan apartment in Mohammedia, head-to-waist: WIFE grabs YOUNG WORKER by the sleeve and pulls him hurriedly through a doorway into a Moroccan salon, glancing back over her shoulder with a worried, urgent face; he looks surprised. Salon banquettes visible behind them. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At the open front door of a Moroccan apartment, head-to-waist: YOUNG WORKER standing on the landing speaks seriously, one hand raised; WIFE in the doorway freezes, eyes wide, hand on the door frame, shocked. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan salon with long patterned banquettes and a round brass tea table, head-to-waist: WIFE sits down very close beside YOUNG WORKER on the banquette, leaning in toward him, intense questioning look; he sits stiffly, nervous, hands on his knees. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in a Moroccan salon: WIFE leans toward YOUNG WORKER gripping his forearm, demanding an answer with a tense face; he looks down, hesitant, about to speak. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon, head-to-waist: WIFE's eyes fill with tears, her hand over her mouth, trembling; YOUNG WORKER beside her looks guilty and awkward, rubbing the back of his neck. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon, head-to-waist: YOUNG WORKER with his hand on his chest swears sincerely, earnest face; WIFE wipes a tear with the end of her headscarf, staring at him hard, believing him. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon in afternoon light, wide-ish but subjects central: WIFE and YOUNG WORKER sit on the banquette in a long serious whispered conversation, tea glasses on the brass table, she gestures angrily toward the door. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon, head-to-waist: WIFE hands YOUNG WORKER a small folded paper with a phone number, looking him straight in the eyes conspiratorially; he takes it hesitantly. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: At the apartment front door, head-to-waist: WIFE presses folded Moroccan banknotes into YOUNG WORKER's hand and closes his fingers over them, serious secretive look; he stares at the money, unsure. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text, faces in the central area, calm edges.
